info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v4-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts API provides access to a comprehensive list of available discounts for auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various discounts offered, aiding customers in identifying potential savings on their policies. Typical consumers include insurance agents, financial advisors, and end-users seeking to optimize their insurance costs. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance their offerings and support clients in making informed decisions regarding auto insurance purchases.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current discounts applicable to quotes. It's useful for determining possible savings or adjustments to pricing based on available offers.
